top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks establish a reproducible precision measurement capability that changes what can be measured. The proposed citation stays with the demonstrated clock development and its complementary contributions, without depending on future applications.
recusal_note: Professional proximity to P007 through my background in atomic physics, laser spectroscopy, and precision measurement. My WACQT leadership also overlaps institutionally with Chalmers and fellow member Göran Johansson; no direct collaboration with the proposed laureates is apparent from my profile.
